Perimeter verticals at grid 1 and grid 4 (mark 'B1') run the full A-to-B span with no mid-split, since no column sits at the 2.25m midpoint on those two lines (the beam-splitting rule §5 only triggers at a column/grid intersection). All other spans (B4 rows, B2/B2'/B3 stairwell members) DO split at the dummy mid-row A'' because a real beam (B4/B3 itself) terminates there.

The stairwell bay (grid2-grid3) uses its own local marks B2 (upper half, A to A''), B2' (lower half, A'' down to a locally-marked point labelled 'Cx' on the drawing) and B3 (the two horizontal headers, at A'' and at the Cx level). 'Cx' has no printed dimension on this sheet or S-02 tying it to the main grid — it is visually just above row B, close to the stair landing detail on the (out-of-scope) A-11 stair sheet. Recorded the Cx-level members' grid_ref using row B as the nearest confirmed grid line, flagged low confidence rather than inventing a precise offset.

'GS' (2 occurrences, top-right and bottom-left of the plan) sits inside the slab-only canopy overhangs beyond row A and beyond row B (1.20m / 1.40m, see grid-master unassigned_dimensions) — no beam label or column at its corners, so no dummy grid was created for it per the dummy-grid rule; its own grid_ref below is approximate ('~' prefixed).

An 'SB' leader/callout sits over the B4 beam near grid2, row A, pointing to the expansion-joint detail defined on S-03 (หน้า18) — recorded as an element there (matching the precedent set by this same detail on other houses in this series), not repeated as a separate plan element here.
